skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK (+10) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 38% ATK (+2) DMG to a single target. Each hit has a 50% chance to deal 10% ATK DMG to enemies around the primary target.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 38% ATK (+2) DMG to a single target. Each hit has a 50% chance to deal 15% ATK DMG to enemies around the primary target.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains (+20) HP. On the first turn, if Mountain Ape is present, increases DMG dealt by Eyelash by 20%, lasting until the end of battle.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains (+20) HP. On the first turn, if Mountain Ape is present, increases DMG dealt by Eyelash by 30%, lasting until the end of battle.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains (+20) HP. On the first turn, if Mountain Ape is present, increases DMG dealt by Eyelash by 35%, lasting until the end of battle.
